issues: Cookie consent banner overlays bottom of viewport on every page. Use force=True for clicks near footer. Not iter318-specific.

critical_code_review_comments: Apply endpoint validates custom_responses BEFORE file checks (CV/MIME/size). When testing in isolation, custom_responses must already be a JSON-valid string containing all required custom_text_fields/custom_date_fields. This is correct fail-fast behaviour but worth documenting in the API spec.
Apply form expects 'preferred_language' (not 'preferred_lang') and 'custom_responses' as a JSON string field (Form(...)) — frontend builder must JSON.stringify the per-label responses object.

DELETE /api/admin/careers/jobs/{id} only succeeds on draft jobs with 0 applicants. Activate→Archive→Delete flow is NOT supported (archived jobs can't be deleted — returns 409 not_draft). Spec said 'DELETE on draft with 0 applicants succeeds' which matches.
Activation requires description_en AND description_fr to be non-empty; returns 422 incomplete_job otherwise. Spec-compliant; UI should surface this missing-fields envelope clearly.
Path-traversal endpoint correctly blocks 'foo/../bar', '..hidden', URL-encoded variants — returns 403 path_traversal_blocked or 404 for unknown filenames inside the applicant dir.

CONTRACTOR_SENDER_EMAIL/NAME hardcoded constants in contractor_email_hub.py — good (immutable per Email Hub spec). The one 'partners@bidvex.ca' string remaining in that file is a CHANGELOG COMMENT only; not a sender value.
